headline: Trump won't confirm WSJ Starlink-pressure report, says service restored'

There was not a single military object anywhere nearby.' AFP/Daily Sabah: 7 dead…
sources: The Times (thetimes.com/world/russia-ukraine-war, updated Oct 23); AFP via Daily Sabah; Zelensky (Telegram); FM Andrii Sybiha (X); Trump (Oval Office remarks); Reuters via monitor.co.ug
fault_line: Is the 'humanitarian' talk a peace channel — or does the Lavra strike prove the diplomacy is theater?

sections.what_happened: Zelensky: one of the three cluster-munition ballistic missiles struck Kyiv's historic centre near the 11th-century Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra monastery — 'deliberate choice of weapon, a deliberate choice of target area... There was not a single military object anywhere nearby.' AFP/Daily Sabah: 7 dead across Ukraine Thursday (Sumy 1, Kharkiv 1, Zaporizhzhia 3, Donetsk 2); Klitschko: 15 wounded in Kyiv; 2 more died in Lozova on Thursday afternoon when drones/missiles hit the central market. Sybiha (X): 'Overnight, Kyiv residents heard what Russian 'humanism' truly sounds like... Appeasement, servility and flattery will not stop this war.' Trump refused to confirm the WSJ report that he pressured Musk to restore Ukraine's Starlink access; hours after Zelensky flagged lagging speeds, Trump said: 'Bottom line, he put it back.' Russia claimed 808 Ukrainian drones downed overnight (single-source MOD figure).
sections.what_verified: AFP via Daily Sabah; The Times; Reuters via monitor.co.ug (21 ballistic missiles/3 waves, 630 Ukrainian drones at Moscow, 252:25 body exchange)
sections.what_disputed: Russia MOD silent on the Kyiv cluster-munition claims; the 808-drone figure is Moscow's alone
sections.why_matters: The update card: cluster munitions on the historic centre while the envoy flies home. Keep tallies attributed; the Starlink saga stays a sidebar, not the story.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to 0200-07 — Kyiv tolls revised: cluster warhead hit historic centre near Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra; Lozova market strike killed 2 Thursday; 7 dead across Ukraine; Sybiha rebukes Witkoff's 'humanitarian' praise; Trump won't confirm WSJ Starlink-pressure report, says service restored

totw_analysis: Our read: The update card: cluster munitions on the historic centre while the envoy flies home. Keep tallies attributed; the Starlink saga stays a sidebar, not the story. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is the 'humanitarian' talk a peace channel — or does the Lavra strike prove the diplomacy is theater?
